plan: 1. Load data.csv. 2. Apply age filter: keep 18<=age<=80. 3. Drop rows with missing glucose_fu or bmi. 4. Code diet: mediterranean=1, usual=0. 5. Fit logistic regression event ~ diet + age + bmi using statsmodels Logit (ML, no penalty). 6. Compute n_model = n obs used, n_events = sum(event). 7. Compute OR = exp(coef) for diet and age, Wald 95% CI = exp(coef +/- 1.96*se) using statsmodels conf_int, p-value from model summary. 8. Print JSON with all claims.
